name: Name

tables.dragHint: Drag a regular column header's right edge to resize. Widths are remembered locally for each table. Selection and action columns have fixed widths.
tables.storageUnavailable: Local preferences are unavailable; width changes or resets apply only to this session.

previewSaveOnly: Confirming saves the candidate only. Confirm initial values and policies, then explicitly load it. The instance stays stopped.
layoutReady: The complete address plan has been validated.
initializeAllHint: All runtime values will be initialized from this revision and rule time reset.
preserveHint: Compatible values are retained. Changed fields or DBs are initialized as listed.
applyAcknowledge: I reviewed the retention, initialization and deletion list. Loading keeps the instance stopped.
tiaInitializersIgnored: TIA := and BEGIN initializers are ignored. Confirm DS initial values for each point; defaults do not represent original PLC values.
sourceBounds: Up to 128 files, 4 MiB total and 1 MiB each. Explicitly choose DB declarations, UDT closure and target DB numbers.
closeConnectionHint: Only this connection is closed. Committed items are retained; a lost reply leaves the client with an unknown result.
maintenanceHint: This write changes neither the initial value nor write owner. A client may overwrite it later. Check old value, new value and version.
writeAcknowledge: I checked this value, revision and sequence
unknownReceipt: Reply unknown. Refresh the current value and sequence before reconfirming; do not retry automatically. After another write, the current readback cannot prove whether the original write succeeded.
emptyInstances: No instances yet. Create one, then import or manually configure its DB points.
resetHint: The instance must be stopped. Discard all current values and restore loaded initial values. It will remain stopped.
loadRevision: Select a saved revision and load while stopped
savedSelectedLoaded: Saving creates a candidate revision. Selected and loaded revisions are tracked separately. Loading still requires an explicit start.
deleteInstanceHint: Stop the instance and release its connections first. Save the deletion explicitly. A failed save preserves the original runtime values.
toManualHint: Original sources are retained, but this DB will be explicitly manual. Reconfirm its complete addresses, names, initial values and policies.
removeDbHint: Remove this DB and its points from the draft. Runtime configuration changes only after saving and loading.
confirmInitialPolicy: Save and confirm selected initial values/policies
removePointHint: Remove this manual point from the draft. Memory changes only after saving and loading.
selectPolicyTarget: Select a policy level and target
policyHint: Properties inherit from instance → DB → non-overlapping region → point. Continuous rules own writes exclusively, including while paused.
pointUpdatedHint: Shanghai time (UTC+08:00), displayed to seconds. Records initialization in the current epoch or this point's last successful commit. Refreshing does not change it; unchanged rule values do not advance it. Loading or resetting initializes metadata again. Monotonic nanoseconds remain separate and are not calendar dates.
writeKindsHint: Ordinary writes require Hold mode, UI ownership and UI-write permission. One-time maintenance writes require Hold mode, client or no ownership and explicit maintenance permission. They change only the current value, not the initial or owner, and do not automatically revert after a timer. Paused continuous rules keep ownership; stopped instances cannot be written. External S7 clients are a separate write source.
calendarTimeHint: Calendar times use Asia/Shanghai (UTC+08:00), displayed to seconds. Original records retain milliseconds; revision sequences distinguish saves within the same second.
effectiveHint: The loaded configuration’s effective property sources are shown below. Draft edits take effect after saving and loading while stopped.
saveApplyHint: Saving neither applies nor starts. Explicitly confirm initial values and policies, complete addresses and names, then load a revision while stopped.
configurationBlocked: Configuration requires confirmation or has conflicts
operationFailed: The operation could not complete. Check configuration and current state.
staleHint: Read failed. The last snapshot is retained; refresh before writing.
unsavedHint: Save the candidate before closing or discard edits. Cancel keeps the window and runtime state. Saving does not apply it.

editing.allDbs: No DB filter: all DBs of this PLC
editing.draftHint: Current configuration draft: effective values and inheritance are an editing preview awaiting server validation, separate from loaded runtime values.
editing.selectAll: Select all filtered points across all pages
editing.batchHint: Only point overrides for these {count} selected points change. Any incompatible point blocks the entire draft update.
editing.modeLinkHint: Setting a mode links owner to none for hold, or rule for continuous modes; clientWrite, uiWrite and uiMaintenance are disabled, and a complete new rule is constructed. Check before/after values before keeping. Other explicitly selected settings must remain compatible.
editing.staleSelection: The instance, filter, point set or draft baseline changed. Cancel and reopen this editor before submitting.
editing.noop: All fields are unchanged, or the candidate has no changes. No draft update or new revision is created.
editing.impact: Before/after values and inheritance for {count} affected points, including mode links:
editing.acknowledge: I reviewed every affected point, values, inheritance and mode links. Keep changes in the configuration draft only.
editing.singlePreview: Explicit overrides at this layer are shown below. Check inherited effective values in the table. Keeping does not save, load or start.
editing.keptDraft: Edits kept in the current draft. Review and save, then explicitly confirm the selected initial values and policies.
editing.saveNotice: Most recently saved revision: {revision}. Saving did not load or start it; check the pending load version on Instances.
editing.versionFacts: Latest saved: {latest}; instance selected: {selected}; currently loaded: {loaded}
editing.notLoaded: The latest saved revision is not loaded into this instance
editing.chosenVersion: Revision for the next load preview: {revision}
editing.historicalVersion: A historical revision is manually selected and remains selected after saves. Choose latest saved revision to change it.
editing.layoutFacts: Review the target DB, length and complete point addresses from the server candidate below.
editing.previewMissing: The candidate has no target DB data. Cancel and preview again.
editing.singleEffectivePreview: Draft effective values and property sources before and after this point edit, including restored inheritance and mode links. Keeping does not save, load or start.
